label: US AI regulation · Colorado AI Act enforced (mid-2027)
prompt: Will the Colorado Attorney General be enforcing SB 24-205 (or a successor high-risk AI statute) against private developers or deployers by 30 June 2027?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if, by the date, the AG has finalised implementing rules and no court order or stipulation bars enforcement. Resolves NO if the law is repealed, replaced by a statute without high-risk duties, or still suspended.

diagnostics.label: Enforcement stipulation
diagnostics.note: April 2026 joint motion: no enforcement until interpretive rulemaking completes.

diagnostics.note: Polis workgroup framework agreed; bill status after the 2026 session unverified.
